item.title: Celadon Air orders 12 A350 aircraft from Airbus
item.author: press@airbus.example (Airbus Media Relations)
item.description: Celadon Air has signed a firm order for 12 A350 aircraft from Airbus.
item.content:encoded:
Celadon Air has signed a firm order for 12 A350 aircraft from Airbus, to renew its long-haul fleet from 2028.

The airline will operate the A350 on routes from its main base.
